svg.title: The Pre-Completion Probate Wholesale Setup
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-probate-wholesale-architecture; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: The Pre-Completion Probate Wholesale Setup; subtitle: One operator, fresh filings, and the parties that make the contract close; caption: Reach the personal representative within 30 days of filing and contract before probate completes; Flip With Rick reports an average near $47,000 per probate deal.; assumptions note: Team size was not reported. Practitioners split on attorneys: Flip With Rick bypasses them as billable-hour blockers, while Al Nicoletti treats them as closing partners.; note: Structure per Flip With Rick, Rick Ginn, and Michael Franke; Rick Ginn pegs probate spreads at 3 to 3.5 times a normal assignment.; center: role: Probate wholesaler; headcount: Not reported; focus: Warm calls at 80/20 or 90/10 listening, no price on the first call, and a price-deposit-terms anchor locked with the PR.; spokes: role: Personal representative; type: Seller; kpi: Letters of administration confirmed; contract re-papered with a new date after they issue; EMD of at least $500.; role: Courthouse or XLeads list pull; type: Lead source; kpi: Filings from the last 30 days only, never older than 90.; role: Cash buyer; type: Exit; kpi: May pay $10,000 more for a faster close; $50 to $75 rekey plus lockbox lets buyers tour without an out-of-state PR.; role: Title company and real estate attorney; type: Closing partner; kpi: Sale process verified in order through the state probate court site, the title company, then the attorney.
